I’ve always loved the name Lila. I actually had it picked out long before I had kids, but ended up with two boys and never got to use it. Maybe one day I’ll get a girl dog and finally have my Lila. 😂

In the meantime, when it came time to name this mat, Lila just felt right.

Lila makes me think of the kind of woman everyone wants at their mahjong table. She’s effortlessly stylish, loves a beautiful home, never shows up empty-handed, and somehow always makes everyone feel welcome.

I imagine her with a beautiful garden, a well-loved home, and a table that’s always ready for friends to gather around. She’s a little old-fashioned in the best possible way, but has a fun, playful side, too.

When I was designing this mat, I kept coming back to that feeling. Something feminine, classic, and timeless, but still full of personality. And somehow, Lila became the perfect fit. 

Photo captured by the very talented whitehouseflowerfarm

Bespoke Mahjong is still very much open and getting bigger and better! Our tiles, tables, accessories and exciting new collections are all continuing. This farewell is just to our local play space. 💕

To everyone who joined us at the House, took a class or made a new friend around our tables, thank you! You filled this special space with laughter, friendship and LOTS of mahjong.

A very special thank-you to Nancy, who has been the heart of HOM from day one! Thank you for making everyone feel so welcome and pouring so much love into our mahjong community. Nancy is staying with the Bespoke team, and we’re so happy she’ll continue this journey with us! 🩷

While we [im]patiently wait for our debut set of tiles to finish production, we thought we’d share a little story behind our Jokers! 🩵🪶✨

These colorful gems have a wink of  nostalgia woven into their design. Sarah and I grew up together here in Winston-Salem, NC, where Robin Hood seems to have left his mark on our side of town. Sherwood Forest, Friar Tuck, and Robinhood Road were all familiar fixtures of our stomping grounds. Our childhood neighborhood was even named after the Prince of Thieves himself. 

As a nod to the place that raised us and the memories we share, we gave our Joker a little twist, borrowing Robin Hood’s iconic cap, complete with a feather stuck in his… well, you know the rest. (Wait, wasn’t that Yankee Doodle? 😉)

Whether you’re a local or not, we think you’ll love the vibrant colors and playful personality these Jokers bring to our Whispering Winds tiles. We have a feeling everyone will be looking to steal from the rich and give to the poor… or, more likely, snag one of these jaunty caps in a Joker swap! 🩵🪶✨

*As we’ve mentioned previously, the tiles pictured are from our sample set, which we have thoughtfully modified after lots of time playing on them. So please note that the final production version does not include the borders! While we loved them on some of the tiles, we felt they took away from the beauty of the hand-illustrated art on others. So they had to go!

Our Whispering Winds tiles are officially in the latter stages of production! While our manufacturing partners are busy engraving, painting, and polishing these babies to perfection, we thought it was time to show you The Winds. 🌬️

This sneak peek is part reveal, part process video, because isn’t it fun to see how something is made?!

Every tile started with Laura’s ideas, hand-drawn in her sketchbook. Believe it or not, this process began LAST SEPTEMBER with hours spent drawing and planning at the kitchen table, on the patio, at piano lessons, even one epic creative session at the car repair shop. 🤪

The vision was colorful, whimsical, directional bursts of wind blowing across the tiles. It has been so much fun watching that idea come to life.

Part of the long process of creating our debut set exactly the way we want it included getting sample sets and actually playing on them. After months of testing and obsessing, we made a few changes—and we want to give you a little behind-the-scenes peek at those decisions, too.

First change: the borders. What you’re seeing here are our sample tiles. We ultimately decided to remove the borders from the final tile design. While we loved how they looked on some tiles, we felt they competed with the artwork on others. We opted for a cleaner, simpler look where the art can shine. ✨

Second change: a little more chunk. We’ve added a touch of thickness to the final tiles for a slightly chunkier, more substantial feel in the hand.

So what do you want to see next? 👀

Timing: our latest update is that the Sky Blue will be ready first, likely toward the end of October. This is a little later than we originally anticipated, but such is life in the mahjong world we have learned! After that, we can’t forget to factor in several weeks of shipping to us. The Tortoise Shell colorway will follow soon thereafter.

Thank you all for the interest, excitement, questions, and support! We’ll keep you posted as we get more updates. We’re hopeful The Whispering Winds just might make it onto your holiday wish lists! 😉🎁
